note: Set A correctly binds several table values to their charge columns (e.g. charge 8 = 36 nm, charge 6 = 15 nm, 1.0 nm, 0.95 nm) and keeps the 2e-11 raw starlight suppression (2.5–3.5 λ/D) condition, whereas Set B never identifies the charge column at all, binding values to 'HabEx 4-Meter Baseline Design' with invented 'Mode 1/2/3' labels or to bare aberration names, so its numbers cannot be verified against the four charge columns. Set A nonetheless misassigns many right-hand (stellar size 1 mas) values to charge 4 (0.36, 0.44, 0.71, 0.35, 0.0065 nm) and invents a 'stellar size 0 mas' condition and a 'Defocus, index 0' reading not in the source. Set B also drops the suppression and 1 mas conditions entirely and includes a trivial index claim, so A yields more genuinely correct, component-bound claims despite its own frequent charge misbindings.
